prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function frequencyLeaders(input: string): string | null
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed decimal integers in -1000..1000. Count occurrences and return every value tied for greatest frequency in increasing numeric order, joined by commas. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 4,2,4,2,9 returns 2,4.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const nums=(s:string):number[]|null=>{if(!s)return null;let o:number[]=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};export function frequencyLeaders(s:string):string|null{let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;let c=new Map;for(const x of a)c.set(x,(c.get(x)||0)+1);let m=Math.max(...c.values());return[...c].filter(x=>x[1]===m).map(x=>x[0]).sort((x,y)=>x-y).join(',')}
